sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the owner of the truck and the said truck met with accident and the deceased who was travelling in the said truck succumbed to injuries.

Therefore the claimants filed the claim petition and the NC: 2023:KHC-D:9122 tribunal after considering the same has awarded compensation and fastened the liability to pay compensation on owner of the truck on the reason that the deceased was a gratuitous passenger in the truck and permit is not issued to make travel any person as a passenger.
Thus by holding that the deceased was a gratuitous passenger, fastened liability on the owner of the truck by exonerating the insurance company.
3. The order of tribunal making appellant owner liable to pay compensation is questioned in this appeal.
It is not disputed that the truck involved is a heavy goods vehicle and the same is not meant for the purpose of carrying passengers.
It is proved that the deceased was travelling in the truck as an unauthorized passenger.

Therefore, the tribunal is correct in making the appellant- owner of the truck liable to pay compensation by exonerating the insurance company since there is violation of condition of insurance policy.
The another contention argued by the learned counsel for appellant owner is that the driver is not made as a party in the claim petition and the driver is a necessary party.
This argument cannot be accepted for the reason that the driver is mere proper party but not necessary party.
Even in the absence of driver, an effective adjudication can be made.
Therefore it is settled law that if the driver is not a party, at the most if he is made as a party, he is only a proper party but not a necessary party.
Therefore, even in the absence of the driver of truck, effective adjudication is made and it is not liable to be interfered with.
5. Therefore, viewed from any angle, there is no merit in the appeal.
Hence the appeal is dismissed.
6. The amount in deposit shall be transmitted to the tribunal.
